assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for Great Voyage, a 2D top-down Age of Sail management game. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG sprite atlas, EXACTLY six isolated objects in a strict 3-column 2-row equal-cell grid (each cell512x512), each object centered inside its cell with at least40px transparent margin. No labels, text, checkerboard or background. Match Prison Architect furniture visual language: crisp continuous dark brown outlines, simple readable shapes, flat clear warm color areas, restrained 2-tone shading, almost no grain. Orthographic top-down furniture with only a small front lip, NOT isometric or side-view illustration. At a modest game scale objects must read cleanly. Row1 left: captain's rectangular navigation desk seen from above, warm walnut, ivory blank chart lying flat, tiny compass and quill in corner, no chair attached. Row1 middle: single wooden bed seen from above, cream pillow at top and muted navy blanket, four dark wooden corner posts, simple. Row1 right: closed wooden sea chest seen from above with brass bands and latch. Row2 left: simple empty warm timber plank floor rectangle nearly filling its cell, no outer border, only subtle evenly spaced joints, intended as a continuous cabin floor panel. Row2 middle: short straight horizontal thick wood cabin partition wall viewed from directly above, rectangular flat top rail with dark clean edges, no floor or cast shadow. Row2 right: small wooden captain's chair seen from directly above with navy seat and backrest at top. Keep each sprite entirely separate and transparent surrounding, consistent brown outline thickness and consistent lighting, no baked surrounding shadow, no perspective vanishing lines, no additional decorations or objects.

refinement.prompt: Edit this wooden floor texture into a clean production tile for a Prison Architect style 2D game. Preserve the warm medium-brown palette, directly overhead view, eight horizontal plank rows and thin dark brown seams. Change only surface rendering and repeat boundaries: REMOVE the dense wood grain scribbles and knots, use nearly FLAT simple color areas with extremely restrained two-tone shading. Keep the entire image opaque and fully filled to all four edges. Make the top and bottom edge meet as a continuous horizontal plank seam when repeated: the seam at the top edge and bottom edge must be consistent, with no double-width board across the wrap. Make left and right edges match in color and plank-row height, with no visible vertical tile cut or harsh lighting change when tiled side by side. Vertical plank end joins must remain sparse and staggered, not aligned as a grid. No outer border, no rounded platform, no shadow, no text, no objects. This must read as a subtle unobtrusive game floor under furniture, not an illustration of wood grain. Deliver only the single clean repeatable square tile, not a preview grid.

imported_sprite_rect.reason: Repeat between horizontal plank seams, avoiding the unseamed outer image edges.
